title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Fungal Tissue for PacBio Sequencing
author: Reynaldi Darma
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9g3h3yn

steps.title: Prepare CTAB extraction buffer
steps.instruction: In each 50 mL Falcon tube (prepare three), mix 13 mL CTAB lysis buffer, 1.5 mL 10 % PVP 10, and 1.5 mL 10 % PVP 40.

steps.title: Harvest and pre‑chill materials
steps.instruction: Scrape fungal tissue from agar plates with a scalpel (e.g., 1.3 g wet weight from 9 plates) and weigh; pre‑chill mortar, pestle, spatula, and sand (1 g sand per 100 mg tissue) with liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Grind tissue with sand
steps.instruction: Add the frozen sand to the tissue in the pre‑chilled mortar and grind 3–4 times, each burst lasting 10–15 seconds, adding liquid nitrogen between bursts; avoid excessive pressure to prevent DNA shearing.

steps.title: Transfer to pre‑heated tubes
steps.instruction: Divide the ground tissue‑sand mixture equally into three 50 mL Falcon tubes that have been pre‑heated to 60 °C and already contain the CTAB extraction buffer prepared in step 1.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K to each tube:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Proteinase K (20 mg mL⁻¹) and incubate at room temperature on an orbital shaker with slow agitation for 1.5 h.
Add 40 µL Proteinase K (same concentration) and incubate at room temperature on an orbital shaker with slow agitation for 1 h.

steps.title: Add RNase A and incubate
steps.instruction: Add RNase A to each tube:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL RNase A (10 mg mL⁻¹) and incubate on the orbital shaker with slow agitation for 30 min at room temperature.
Add 20 µL RNase A to 400 µL of the crude DNA preparation and incubate for 1 h at room temperature on the orbital shaker with slow agitation.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (first)
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1) to each tube (e.g., 16 mL total for the batch), mix slowly several times, then centrifuge at 5 000 g for 10 min at room temperature; carefully transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Pool aqueous phases and PCI (small)
steps.instruction: Combine all aqueous phases into one tube, adjust the total volume to 5 mL with 10 mM Tris (pH 8), then add 460 µL PCI, mix slowly several times, and centrifuge at 8 000 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Additional PCI extraction
steps.instruction: To the pooled extract, add one volume of PCI (5 mL), mix slowly, centrifuge at 5 000 g for 10 min, and collect the clear aqueous phase (≈3 mL); repeat PCI if a milky interphase remains.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with NaAc and isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) – 300 µL – to the aqueous phase, mix slowly, then add one volume of isopropanol (3.3 mL) and mix slowly.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 500 g for 20 min, discard the supernatant, add 5 mL fresh 70 % ethanol, and incubate the mixture for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash and pellet reduction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7 500 g for 20 min at room temperature, discard most of the supernatant leaving ~1 mL, then:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL fresh 70 % ethanol, mix gently, and centrifuge at 7 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Repeat the 1 mL ethanol wash once more, followed by centrifugation at 7 500 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet and resuspend
steps.instruction: Discard the final supernatant, air‑dry the pellet for ~15 min, then add 400 µL (or 500 µL) 10 mM Tris (pH 8) and let the pellet dissolve overnight at room temperature or 4 °C.

steps.title: Check dissolution and quantify DNA
steps.instruction: If the pellet has not fully dissolved, incubate at 37 °C for 10–20 min; then measure DNA concentration and purity using Qubit and Nanodrop.

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a 0.45× AMPure XP bead cleanup and size selection according to the bead manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Final QC of purified DNA
steps.instruction: Re‑measure DNA concentration and purity with Qubit and Nanodrop, and run pulsed‑field gel electrophoresis to assess fragment size distribution.
